optimizedContext.value:
# List Archived

## Rules
- Constructor sole dep: `ArchiveRepository` (default workspace, kernel-injected)
- `ListArchived.execute(options?)` forward optional `limit`/`page`/`after`/`includeArchivedBy` to `ArchiveRepository.list(options)`
- Default `limit` **100**; `page` and `after` mutually exclusive per `ListOptions`
- Return `Promise<ListResult<ArchiveListEntry>>` (alias `ListArchivedResult`)
- Order=`archivedAt` desc; `meta.total`=full count; `meta.count`=page size
- Keyset `after: { key: archivedAt ISO-8601, id: change name }` — not legacy `startAt`
- Delegate entirely to `ArchiveRepository.list(options)`; MUST NOT re-filter/sort/paginate/transform
- MUST NOT mutate state, write repos, run hooks, or trigger lifecycle
- Config form → `resolveListArchivedDeps(resolver)` → `createListArchived(deps)`; resolve `archive: ArchiveRepository`; MUST NOT inline fs wiring

## Constraints
- No own error cases — errors from `ArchiveRepository` infra
- No workspace selection — uses injected `ArchiveRepository` only
- `ArchiveListEntry` immutable read-only
- Optional `archivedBy` only when `includeArchivedBy` set
